title: Appliances installed in rooms that are not large in comparison with the size of the appliance.
officialText:
Air-conditioning appliances
installed in rooms that are not large in comparison with the size of the appliance, such as alcoves and closets, shall be listed for such
installations and installed in accordance with the manufacturer’s instructions. Listed clearances shall not be reduced by the protection
methods described in Table 308.2, regardless of whether the enclosure is of combustible or noncombustible material.
